objective: Keep the formatter and linter off the holyagent state folder so `mise run verify` passes with Intent state present.
scope: `mise run verify` fails on fmt:check only because of JSON files the holyagent CLI writes under .holyagent/. Add `/.holyagent` to .prettierignore and .eslintignore, with a one-line comment in the style of those files saying the CLI writes it.
Then run `mise run verify` and report its exit code and counts.
constraints: Do not commit, push, branch or touch .git; never write or reformat anything under .holyagent.
Change only the two ignore files.

criteria.text: `mise run verify` exits 0 with the .holyagent state files present.
